title: Kairos: Toward a Byte-Level Foundation Model for Every Modality
abstract: arXiv:2610.12495v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Small language models trained on a single local machine leave little room for architectural trial and error. Kairos combines bidirectional gated-DeltaNet linear attention and sliding-window attention over shared projections (LiZAttention2), block-wise Attention-Residual aggregation, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) feed-forward layer and a multi-scale byte-level codec, trained with a uniform-noise denoising objective over one byte space shared by text, image, audio, video, lidar and control streams; this report asks whether the combination optimizes at all before asking whether it is useful. We give code-derived algorithms for each component, including a cross-session recurrent-state memory gate, then run convergence sanity checks: overfittinga single 440-byte sentence at 1--15M parameters, text only, with three seeds for codec and attention choices and single-run sweeps for seven further factors. translated_title: Kairos：迈向适用于所有模态的字节级基础模型
translated_abstract: 在单台本地机器上训练的小型语言模型几乎没有留下架构试错的空间。Kairos 结合了基于共享投影的双向门控 DeltaNet 线性注意力与滑动窗口注意力（LiZAttention2）、分块的注意力-残差聚合、稀疏混合专家（MoE）前馈层，以及多尺度字节级编解码器，在文本、图像、音频、视频、激光雷达和控制流共享的统一字节空间上，以均匀噪声去噪目标进行训练；本报告在追问这种组合是否有用之前，先追问它究竟能否正常优化。我们给出了每个组件由代码推导出的算法，包括一个跨会话的循环状态记忆门控，随后进行收敛性健全性检查：在 1–15M 参数规模下对单个 440 字节的句子进行过拟合测试（仅文本），其中对编解码器和注意力选择使用三个随机种子，并对另外七个因素进行单次运行的参数扫描。所测试的两个注意力变体在……
tldr: Kairos 提出了一种在统一字节空间上处理文本、图像、音频、视频、激光雷达等多模态的小型基础模型架构，融合门控 DeltaNet 线性注意力、滑动窗口注意力、注意力-残差聚合、稀疏 MoE 和多尺度字节级编解码器，并通过单机上的小规模过拟合收敛测试验证该组合能否有效优化。
en_tdlr: Kairos combines bidirectional gated-DeltaNet linear attention, sliding-window attention, Attention-Residual aggregation, sparse MoE, and a multi-scale byte-level codec in a unified byte space for all modalities, and validates through small-scale overfitting convergence checks whether this architectural combination can actually optimize.
